description: This file defines an interface 'IStateMachineLogWriter' for writing log entries related to a state machine, including methods for appending log entries with different parameters.

methods.name: AppendEntry
methods.description: Method for appending a log entry with a delegate Action that takes a state and a byte buffer writer.

methods.name: AppendEntries
methods.description: Method for appending multiple log entries with a delegate Action that takes a state and a StateMachineStorageWriter.
